description:
List the coach's A/B tests, newest first, optionally filtered by status. Variant config comes back as stored, since its shape depends on what the test compares. Creating, starting, stopping, and adopting a test stay in the Luca app.

Luca operation: GET /api/ab-tests
Required scopes: learning:read
Required OAuth scope: luca:read; data sensitivity: full_content
Does not require idempotency.
Use workspaceId or workspaceSlug to override the default workspace configured by environment.
name: luca_learning_ab_tests_list
title: List A/B tests
